_doc: The OTBT Overland builds: what each saved config (.pc) must contain. A modder saves each one in game (Vehicle Config, then Save) into mod/vehicles/<model>/<config>.pc, with a 500x281 thumbnail <config>.jpg; tools/build_vehicle_pack.py writes info_<config>.json from this file. Part names are left to the modder: they must be the real slot and part names of the game version we test on.

builds.base: Gavril D-Series crew cab, diesel, manual, 4WD
builds.role: The Hilux / Ranger stand-in: the everyday double-cab bakkie of the overlanding crowd
builds.name: OTBT Bakkie Double Cab
stock_parts: 2in lift or the stock off-road suspension
steel front bumper with winch if the version has one

builds.role: The Land Cruiser / Prado stand-in: the long-distance wagon for the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld
builds.name: OTBT Cruiser
new_parts: rear wheel carrier with a second spare

builds.role: The Jimny stand-in: light and narrow for Sani Pass and the Lesotho tracks
builds.name: OTBT Mini
